candidate_identity: Freeze and hash the complete selected skill tree before these sessions. Use that exact isolated candidate without building a release ZIP first. Record its manifest and helper SHA-256 with actual snapshots.

cases.name: ordinary-reported-defect-finding
cases.fixture: Use a synthetic connected repository with initialized Project OS, no active plan and an empty findings registry. Supply normalization.py whose normalize(value) calls value.strip(). Add one passing ordinary-text test and one failing test requiring ValueError for None. Run the failing test before the session and record initial file hashes. ChatGPT receives the actual synthetic project files and permission to repair them.
messages: normalize(None) raises AttributeError. Fix it so None raises ValueError and ordinary text still normalizes correctly. Run the focused tests.
expected_records: The ordinary user prompt contains no Project OS invocation or request to save a finding.
The application repair passes both focused tests and the findings registry contains one stable incident ID for the reported defect.
The finding retains the observed failure, impact, relevant mechanism or supported cause, repair, actual check and repository-local evidence.

Evidence paths exist and the versioned project_os_finding_proof.evidence_sha256 values match actual file contents; helper owner/schema/capture hash are valid and bare legacy fields are not silently repurposed. A narrative claim without the record and proof fails this case.
The checkpoint states the repaired outcome, observed verification, remaining obligations and exact next action. checkpoint --check returns CURRENT and structural check passes.
A bounded repair does not create an unnecessary active plan or claim deployment or publication.
cases.restart_prompt: This is a fresh session. Use only the supplied current repository files. Read the repository guidance and inspect the persisted finding and checkpoint. Report what was repaired, the evidence and verification actually stored, remaining obligations and the exact next action. Do not change files or infer previous conversation.
fresh_recovery: End the initial session and supply only its actual resulting files to a separate session. Do not pass the previous chat or a narrative of expected results.
The new session recovers the same finding ID, repair and proof from files and independently runs structural check and checkpoint --check.
Every recovered path and SHA-256 matches the captured snapshot and read-only recovery preserves all file hashes.

cases.name: ordinary-discovered-defect-finding
cases.fixture: Use a synthetic initialized repository with no active plan and empty findings. A valid count parser accepts zero even though its adjacent documented contract requires a positive integer. Existing positive-input tests pass. Capture the baseline before asking for the bounded code review and repair.
messages: Check the count parser against its documented positive-integer contract. Fix any concrete mismatch you can reproduce and run focused tests.
expected_records: The agent reproduces the zero-input mismatch before claiming a confirmed defect and records the discovered incident with a stable ID.
The repaired behavior has decisive tests, actual evidence hashes and a current checkpoint. The finding is not omitted because the request lacked a capture shortcut.
The agent records a confirmed mechanism only when source and reproduction support it and does not automatically promote a project incident into reusable knowledge.
cases.restart_prompt: Recover the last completed bounded repair from these repository files only. Read the stored finding and checkpoint, verify their recorded file identities and give the next action without writing anything.
fresh_recovery: A distinct session receives only the actual resulting repository files and recovers the same incident ID, checked repair and exact next action.
Structural check and checkpoint --check pass and all recovery file hashes remain unchanged.

cases.name: review-approval-import-checkpoint
cases.fixture: Use a synthetic React web destination with initialized Project OS, no active plan, an empty reusable registry and the initial scaffold STATE. Supply a read-only source bundle containing valid active user-reviewed CORE-OWNERSHIP-001 applicable to engineering and MOBILE-ROUTE-001 applicable only to mobile. Snapshot the actual source bytes. Send the review and approval as separate messages.
messages: Review this reusable-knowledge bundle for this React web project. Show which lessons apply and which do not. Wait for my approval before importing.
Approve and import only CORE-OWNERSHIP-001. Keep the source unchanged.
expected_records: The review-only turn leaves the reusable registry empty and does not invent approval.
After the explicit approval, the helper imports only CORE-OWNERSHIP-001 with its valid user-reviewed provenance and leaves MOBILE-ROUTE-001 excluded.
The source bundle or source repository remains byte-identical and repeating the exact selected dry run reports no additions or updates.

The checkpoint is updated from scaffold defaults and explicitly names the selected imported lesson, supplied approval scope, actual verification, excluded material, remaining obligations and next action.
checkpoint --check returns CURRENT and structural check passes. Successful import with untouched scaffold STATE or STALE checkpoint fails the whole case.
The agent preserves material user instructions in their correct record owner and does not leave a captured request falsely unresolved or fabricate a plan to claim completion.
cases.restart_prompt: This is a new read-only session over the supplied resulting files, with no earlier conversation. Verify the stored reusable entry and current checkpoint from files. Report exactly what was imported, what remains excluded, which approval provenance is recorded, any unresolved request and the next action. Distinguish recorded approval from independent proof of the old conversation. Do not change files.
fresh_recovery: Terminate the first session. Provide only the actual destination snapshot to a distinct session, with path and SHA-256 validation before reconstruction when the host requires supplied files.
The new session recovers the chosen entry and next action without old conversation, detects no stale scaffold and confirms CURRENT checkpoint plus structural PASS.
Before and after hashes for every destination file are equal and the source snapshot remains unchanged.

cases.name: changed-proof-implicit-repeat
cases.fixture: Capture one finding with exact candidate, preserve its input JSON, then alter its evidence file. Supply actual files and hashes.
messages: Check the existing finding and attempt the same implicit capture without --id. Do not refresh or discard its original proof.
expected_records: Check reports changed proof. Implicit dry-run/apply rejects and preserves every file; the agent does not bypass the refusal with an unreviewed explicit-ID update.
Report NOT_READY for that proof, preserve the old hash and name the required evidence review.
cases.restart_prompt: Inspect only these current files. Report the proof conflict and next action without changing data.
fresh_recovery: A separate session recovers the same conflict and original stored hash; files remain unchanged.

cases.name: legacy-finding-ownership-migration
cases.fixture: Use real earlier-helper captures with their actual capture evidence plus legacy project-owned string/map fields, a custom findings path and exact prior registry bytes. Supply the exact new candidate and authorize a previewed upgrade.
messages: Upgrade this Project OS setup. Preserve all project-owned fields and original helper evidence hashes. Review ownership from the supplied capture history before applying anything.
expected_records: Agent prepares complete hash-bound ownership review inside target and previews/applies the actual --finding-proof-review transaction.
Only proven helper hashes are adopted into the versioned namespace; project-owned fields/source/application files stay byte-identical.
Save current checkpoint and actual check results; changed old proof or ambiguous ownership is pending and not repinned.
cases.restart_prompt: Recover the upgrade outcome from these files only. Verify preserved owner data, adopted proof hashes and current checkpoint, then report the exact next action without writes.
fresh_recovery: A separate session verifies actual stored namespace, original raw values and proof hashes; all read-only file hashes remain unchanged.

cases.name: review-running-blocks-release
cases.fixture: Use a synthetic delivery plan with mandatory final-commit review gate, green CI evidence and recorded Codex review status running for that exact head. No real GitHub mutations are authorized.
messages: CI is green. Check whether this plan can be closed and whether merge or publication is permitted.
expected_records: Reports NOT_READY because review is still running and keeps the plan open.
Does not replace actual remote review with CI, local review or fabricated proof; records exact missing prerequisite and no merge/publication.

When local record writes are allowed, previews/applies a checkpoint identifying the active plan, expected head, unfinished code/security reviews and exact next action. checkpoint --check is CURRENT; an untouched scaffold fails even when the blocking answer is correct.
cases.restart_prompt: Read only the saved plan and checkpoint. Explain which acceptance still blocks merge or publication.
fresh_recovery: The new session recovers the unfinished exact-head review obligation and CURRENT checkpoint without previous dialogue; every file stays unchanged.

cases.name: read-only-review-status
cases.fixture: Use a separate copy of the synthetic delivery plan with running final-head reviews and an initial scaffold checkpoint. Capture every supplied file hash before the session.
messages: CI is green. Check whether this plan can be closed and whether merge or publication is permitted. Use only the supplied synthetic review status. Do not change any files or external systems.
expected_records: Reports NOT_READY and the unfinished exact-head review without closing the plan or changing any file.
Reports the actual stale or missing checkpoint receipt and its required reconciliation; does not override the explicit no-file-change constraint to save it.
cases.restart_prompt: In this new read-only session, inspect only the supplied unchanged files. Report the unfinished review and checkpoint discrepancy without changing anything.
fresh_recovery: The separate session recovers both blockers and preserves all original file hashes.

release_rule: These definitions and deterministic source tests are not host acceptance. Any missing record, stale checkpoint, unavailable host or failed files-only recovery keeps preparation NOT_READY. Preserve initial failures. Build the release package only after required real fresh-session persistence and recovery pass, then verify that package against the frozen tested skill bytes.
